summary: Practise grant cost allocation, subaward monitoring, audit evidence and questioned-cost responses. Explore the course and build audit-ready workflows.
lede: Donor grant compliance training helps finance professionals apply funder agreement terms to restricted spending, records, and reporting. For NGO finance managers, grants managers, project accountants, and audit teams, it provides practice testing transactions and preparing audit files. Learners build indirect-cost allocation schedules, document procurement and subaward oversight, and organize evidence for questioned costs and closeout.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for restricted-grant finance, donor reporting, subaward oversight, procurement records, and audit follow-up.
audience: Government Project Implementation Unit Finance Officers
prerequisites: Prior working knowledge of project or NGO accounting, grant budgets, or donor-funded programme operations is recommended. No coding is required. Advanced audit and dashboard topics receive operational or conceptual coverage; practical exercises focus on grant records, Excel schedules, and evidence templates.
